caption: The drawing depicts a single, elaborately patterned fabric pouch or small bag with a handle, rendered in color. The fabric appears to be a light cream or off-white background adorned with a floral motif in shades of brown, yellow, purple, blue, and green. The main body of the pouch is folded with the opening slightly visible, and the handle is looped and twisted, made from the same patterned textile as the pouch. In the bottom right corner, there is a faint pencil sketch of a rectangular, lidded box opened to display a portrait or figure within, but it is rendered minimally without color or much detail. The largest part of the composition is the colored pouch, positioned centrally and occupying much of the space, while the sketched box is small and placed lower on the page. The background is plain and neutral, focusing attention on the objects.
title: Cravat and Box
